new_counterexample_search.coherent_mutation: Frozen negative fixtures alter comparison roster, schema, parent, executed source, result, tool exit, partial stdout or acknowledgment contents; these reject even when the local fixture recomputes marker and caller-record hashes.
new_counterexample_search.stale_return_and_path: completed() hashes the retained JSON file bytes, checks exit=0, and compares its parsed full output to a response rebuilt from the current success marker. Changed retained bytes, wrong phase/parent, or stale response against changed marker are rejected. Exact path is supplied by caller and is hashed; filesystem symlink/hostile same-user attacks are expressly outside scope.
new_counterexample_search.process_and_retry: Tiny tests preserve exclusive claims and reject automatic retry after crash/partial reservation. Publisher emits success only after child reaping and comparison validation; completed replay is read-only. No graph or actual phase ran.
